items.text: number port karwana hai
sim replace karni hai
port request hai
haan ji
abhi karna hai
jaldi kar do

items.context: Kya aap apna number port karwana chahte hain?
items.text: haan ji

items.context: Kab tak aapko sim replace chahiye?
items.text: kal tak

items.context: Kya main aapka request lodge karun?
items.text: theek hai
mera number dusre network par port karwana hai
kya aap mujhe sim replace karne ke procedure bata sakte hain
maine apna sim khoya hai isliye replace chahiye
kya port karwane ka koi charge lagega mujhe
mera data balance transfer ho jayega kya port karne par
sim swap karna hai kyunki mera sim damaged ho gaya
port request kab tak complete hoti hai normal conditions mein

items.context: Kya aap port karwana chahenge ya sirf sim replace?
items.text: main port karwana chahta hoon lekin form bharna hai

items.context: Aapko sim replace karna hai ya number port karna hai?
items.text: sim replace karni hai kyunki purani sim ka signal problem kar raha hai

items.context: Aap number port karwana chahte hain to documents ready hain?
items.text: port karwana hai aur batao ki documents kaunse lagenge

items.context: Aapko new sim bhi chahiye port karne ke sath?
items.text: dabbe mein milne wala sim chahiye aur port request karna hai

items.context: Kya aap apna number kisi aur network pe shift karna chahte hain?
items.text: mera number dusre operator pe bhejna hai traffic badh raha hai yahan
mera number Airtel se Jio mein port karwana hai kyunki yahan ka coverage problem karta hai
pichle hafte maine port request di thi lekin ab tak process complete nahi hui hai
sim replace karwane ke liye main nearest store pe gaya tha par wahan sim available nahi thi
main chahata hoon mera purana number sara data aur balance ke sath port ho jaye bina kisi rukawat ke
kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain port request ke liye identity proof kaunse valid hain aur kya process hai
agar main number port karta hoon to existing sim ki jo validity hai wo extend hoti hai kya automatic
mera sim pura din nahi chal raha tha isiliye maine naye sim ke liye apply kiya hai ju connect ho jaye jaldi se

items.context: Port karne ke liye aapko kya jankari chahiye?
items.text: main poora process samajhna chahta hoon kyunki pehli baar number port kar raha hoon

items.context: Aapne port request kab ki thi aur kitne din ho gaye?
items.text: mera number port karwana hai ek mahine se lekin operator se koi response nahi aa raha hai

items.context: Kya aap assure kar sakte ki port hone ke baad bhi aapka balance safe rahega?
items.text: main chahata hoon ki mera existing balance aur number dono safe rahe port hone ke baad bhi

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: port_or_sim - wants to port the number, replace or swap a SIM
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: plain and direct

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
